name: Murrieta Public Library Volunteers and Teen Advisory Council
what_you_do: Help with library events, storytime, the seed library, shelving and the Summer Reading Challenge, or join the Teen Advisory Council.
who_can_apply: Volunteers must be at least 14. Under 18 you fill out an extra section and a parent or guardian must sign. All volunteers must clear Live Scan fingerprinting.
deadline_text: No dates or deadline on the form.
how_to_apply: Fill out and sign the Volunteer Application (PDF). The form does not say where to return it, so ask at the Murrieta library (8 Town Square).
notes: The form lists the Teen Advisory Council as one option but gives no details about it. Confirm first how to return the form.
